 Follow Jessica Chastain Reacts To Lisa Barlow & Meredith Marks’ Performance
 NBC Fri, November 6, 2026 at 3:16 AM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. During Bravo Oh No They Didn't, Oscar winner Jessica Chastain shares her Bravo hot takes. She names her standout RHONY star of the season, weighs in on whether leaving Daisy off Erika's birthday party guest list was warranted, reacts to Lisa Barlow and Meredith Marks' performance at Bronwyn's event, and shares her thoughts on Heather Gay's man.
